messages:
maria_cs: Quick check — prep for cohort-Delta final enrollment & feedback loop. We have 5 seats left, 3 customers pending webhook confirmations. Listing: Atlas (needs webhook), Zephyr (waiting SSO), Ember (manual onboarding). Can we align on next steps?

devon_se: I'll own Atlas webhook. I'll run a quick test and post the curl. If it still 502s, we'll switch to the fallback ingestion path.

sam_prod: I'll draft the feedback pulse (2 Qs) and a short onboarding satisfaction question. Plan to keep it <30s. Will share link here when done.

maria_cs: Also flagging renewal risk for Zephyr — they asked about data residency and SLA. AE asked for a one-pager. We should have talking points for Thu call.

devon_se: Proposed call Thu 10:00am PT — I'll send the invite. Note: infra logs show Atlas returned intermittent 502s last night, stacktrace below.

devon_se: ```
[2023-04-12T02:14:07Z] upstream error: connection reset by peer
service: ingestion-worker-03
route: /v1/events/webhook
status: 502
```

onboard-bot: Reminder: NPS pulse scheduled — sent to cohort-Delta at 2023-04-12T15:00Z :mailbox_with_mail:

maria_cs: Action items: @devon_se remediate Atlas webhook + post validation, @sam_prod publish survey and prepare the Zephyr SLA one-pager, I'll run the enablement call and coordinate AE. Who can help with the Zephyr one-pager?

devon_se: Will test and post results here by EOD. If failure persists I'll open a priority ticket with eng-runtime.

sam_prod: Survey link ready: https://tiny.redwood/survey-delta — Q1: "How likely are you to recommend Redwood Inference? (0-10)" Q2: "Any blockers in integration?" I'll also add a checkbox for data residency concerns.

maria_cs: Perfect. If Atlas fails again, fallback to dedicated basic integration and escalate to infra lead. tagging renewal-risk: Zephyr — loop in @ae and @security for residency options. :warning:

devon_se: Test complete — webhook responded 200 after a small timeout tweak. Sample payload: `{"status":"ok","events":23}`. Pushed config change to staging.

maria_cs: Great — closing Atlas blocker for now. Invite sent for Thu 10:00am PT.

sam_prod: I'll add survey results to cohort dashboard and set an alert if negative feedback >30%.

maria_cs: Thanks team — keep updates here only. Short notes preferred. :thumbsup:
